GATOSSA.NeedLib: Gato's Scene AI: The gatos-lib module must be enabled.

ProviderMenu.Name: AI Connection
ProviderMenu.Label: AI Connection Settings
ProviderMenu.Hint: Choose the AI service (API key) or local LLM server that will read the map. This setting is saved only in the browser you are using now.

Control.Open: Scene AI: Auto-set grid, walls, and lights

Panel.Title: Scene AI
Panel.NoScene: No scene is open on the canvas.
Panel.NoProvider: AI connection is not set up
Panel.NoBackground: This scene has no background image. Add a background, then open it again.
Panel.HexUnsupported: Hex grid scenes do not support wall and light analysis. Switch to a square grid or no grid.

Provider.Title: Scene AI — AI Connection Settings
Provider.Intro: You need a vision model that can view images. Requests are sent directly from this browser to the address below, and map images are sent to that service.
Provider.TypeHint: Selecting a service sets this automatically. For a server you entered yourself, choose the format that server follows.
Provider.LocalHint: Local servers must allow browser requests (CORS). For Ollama, add the Foundry address to the OLLAMA_ORIGINS environment variable; for LM Studio, enable CORS in the server settings. The llama.cpp server allows it by default.
Provider.ApiKeyHint: Stored only in this browser's storage and not passed to the world or players. Leave empty for local servers.
Provider.ModelHint: Type a model name or click 'List' to choose from the models the server provides.
Provider.MaxImagePxHint: The length of the longer side of one tile sent to the AI. Larger is more accurate but slower and more expensive.
Provider.JsonModeHint: If the server supports it, forces JSON-formatted responses. On servers that do not support it, this is turned off automatically and the request is retried.
Provider.Listed: Loaded {count} models. Click the model field to choose one.
Provider.ListedNone: The server did not report any models. Please type a name manually.
Provider.TestOk: Connected: the {model} model read the image correctly.
Provider.TestNoVision: A response came back, but the image does not seem to have been read. Check that this is a vision model. (Response: {answer})

Grid.Hint: Finds the grid drawn on the map and aligns the Foundry grid to it. Grid size, scene size, and background position will change.
Grid.UseAi: Verify result with AI (if the map has no grid, AI estimates the scale)

Verdict.Shifted: Size is correct but position appears offset
Verdict.Wrong: Does not match the map grid
Verdict.Nogrid: No grid drawn; scale looks plausible

Grid.StartAi: Finding grid on map and verifying with AI…
Grid.NotFound: Could not find a grid. The map may be too small or the background cannot be read.
Grid.Found: Grid found. Click 'Apply to scene' to apply it.
Grid.FoundLow: No clear grid is visible, so the result may not be reliable. Turn on 'Verify result with AI' and try again.
Grid.FoundLowAi: The drawn grid is not clear, so the scale estimated by AI was used. Please check visually after applying.
Grid.FoundDoubt: A grid was found, but the AI judged it to look misaligned. After applying, drag it into alignment yourself with Grid Align.
Grid.ConfirmPlaced: This scene already has {count} placed objects such as walls or tokens. Changing the grid and scene size may misalign them with the map. Continue?
Grid.Undone: Grid reverted to the values before applying.

Analyze.Hint: Splits the map into tiles, shows them to the AI, and receives wall, door, and light positions. Results are first shown as a preview on the canvas. Align the grid first for best accuracy.
Analyze.TileCellsHint: The area shown to the AI at once. Smaller is more accurate but increases the number of requests.
Analyze.SnapHint: Sets the grid unit the AI coordinates snap to. Dungeons with mostly right angles work best with half cells; organic cave maps work better with quarter cells or no snapping.
Analyze.LightScaleHint: Defaults are 4 cells for bright light and 8 cells for dim light for a torch (20/40 ft on a 5 ft grid).
Analyze.Overview: First survey the whole map (adds 1 request)
Analyze.OverviewHint: Determines the map type and how walls and doors are drawn first, then informs each tile analysis.
Analyze.PreviewHint: Preview is shown on the canvas: yellow = walls, purple = doors, red = secret doors, sky blue = windows, circles = lights.
Analyze.Replace: Remove walls and lights previously created by AI before applying
Analyze.Failed: {failed} of {tiles} tiles were left out because the AI response could not be read.
Analyze.Done: Analysis complete: {walls} walls, {doors} doors, {lights} lights. Check the preview on the canvas.
Analyze.Applied: Applied to scene: {walls} walls, {doors} doors, {lights} lights (deleted {removed} previous generated objects).

Remove.Title: Delete AI-Generated Objects
Remove.Confirm: This will delete the {walls} walls and doors and {lights} lights that Scene AI created in this scene. Walls and lights you drew yourself will be kept.

Error.Network: Could not connect to the server. Check that the address is correct, the server is running, and, for local servers, that browser requests (CORS) are allowed. OpenAI also reports a wrong API key this way.
Error.Timeout: The response timed out. Increase the timeout in connection settings or reduce the tile size.
Error.Auth: The API key was rejected. Check that the key matches the service.
Error.Notfound: Address or model not found. Check the server address and model name.
Error.Rate: Rate limit reached. Try again shortly or reduce the number of concurrent requests.
Error.Empty: The model sent an empty response.
Error.Config: AI connection settings are incomplete. Check the server address and model.
Error.ImageLoad: Failed to load the background image.
Error.ImageTainted: The background image is hosted on another site that does not allow reading it (CORS). Move the image into the Foundry data folder.
Error.JsonTruncated: The model response was cut off partway. Try reducing the tile size.
Error.JsonInvalid: No result (JSON) was found in the model response.
